message: ナーサティアの玉座

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, Demon Lord, let's play a game」

name: Synn
message: 「I'll pass today」

name: Paqy
message: 「Even just a fleet battle is fine, come on!!」

name: Synn
message: 「You get a wider screen when you play alone, you know?」

name: Paqy
message: 「I don't have enough firepower all by myself!!」
With no other choice, I decided to become a space pirate on the side.

name: Paqy
message: 「Jeez. You don't gotta go out of your way to do Student Council work even on your day off」

name: Synn
message: 「Everyone else is working hard too, after all. I can't just sit back and relax on my own」

name: Paqy
message: 「So you're sitting stiffly on your knees instead?」

name: Synn
message: 「Someone's at the door」

name: Synn
message: 「Coming~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hello~♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte!?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mr. President. Since it's a rare day off, I decided to come over and hang out」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yeah...」
Lolotte appearing out of nowhere is nothing new, yet just having the girl I like right beside me still makes my heart pound.

name: Synn
message: 「Are you... alone today?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I am, yes... Was it a bad idea for me to come alone?」

name: Synn
message: 「No, not at all!」
Alone with Lolotte, huh... My heart starts racing even faster.
I have to make sure I don't get too nervous and show an uncool side of myself.

name: Paqy
message: 「Yo, angel」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I am not an angel--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Wait, I didn't need to hide that anymore, did I. Eheh」
Paqy helped lighten the mood.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Oh...? Having this outfit here means, Mr. President」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. I still had a little bit left unfinished」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Didn't you say yourself to take it easy on days off, Senpai--」

name: Synn
message: 「Ugh」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Well, even so, you just can't help doing it anyway, right\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「Wait, does that mean you also do it at home, Lolotte...?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's a secret~♪」
Saying that, Lolotte energetically rolls up her sleeves.

name: Synn
message: 「Want to do it together, Lolotte?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「No. I'll pretend I didn't see anything. And in the meantime, I'll whip up some lunch for you, President」

name: Synn
message: 「Lunch, for me...?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ehehe. The time has come to test the fruits of my training--!」

name: Synn
message: 「No, no, you don't have to. I'll help out too」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Please hurry up and finish that, President. Once you do, let's take it nice and slow together♪」
With those words, Lolotte headed toward the kitchen.

name: Synn
message: 「I wonder if she'll be okay...?」
She really did try her hardest last time, and if it's just curry rice--

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hyaaaa!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte!?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「No, you mustn't come in!! That was just a little side entertainment!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Side entertainment...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Anyway, you mustn't move until you're done sewing!」
Mmph... In that case, I won't let her beat me--I'll finish this up fast too!

name: Paqy
message: 「Not looking too good over there. Sorry, pal, but I'm gonna pass...」

name: Synn
message: 「I believe in Lolotte!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Welp, guess I'll just eat out」

name: Synn
message: 「You're just a plushie!!」
Though I threw it together in a mad rush and panic.

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa... When I rush it, there are so many flaws... This won't do...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Haste makes sweet, you know♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Sweet gravy!?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Bzzzt. It's a proper lunch, actually」

name: Synn
message: 「Hm, this aroma is...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Always eating just curry and rice leaves your nutritional balance skewed, after all」

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte... You even pay attention to that side of me」

name: Lolotte
message: 「And so, it's my favorite, Hamburg steak--\s07」

name: Synn
message: 「Oooooh」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Unfortunately, it's not 100% beef」

name: Synn
message: 「No way...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「However, a half-and-half mix is actually tastier♪」

name: Synn
message: 「I see, that makes sense! Wait, Lolotte... you can make Hamburg steak?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes. Back home, Sebastian passed the recipe down to Amyrina and me together」

name: Synn
message: 「Is that so. Even so, it's just you here today, Lolotte?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Because it's a \{secret rendezvous|\s12\s12\s12\s12}...\s04」

name: Lolotte
message: 「A-A-Anyway, you see\s01 Let's eat up before it gets cold!」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah!」
I dig into the piping-hot Hamburg steak.

name: Synn
message: 「Nom, nom...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「*Excited fidgeting*♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh」

name: Synn
message: 「It's delicious!!」

name: Synn
message: 「It's so good!! So this is a beef-and-pork blend...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ehehe. It's the power of \{matching|\s12\s12}, you could say」

name: Synn
message: 「You eat too, Lolotte」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Eh... y-yes~\s01」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Nom... munch, munch」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's delicious~~\s07」

name: Synn
message: 「That's amazing. Even though until just the other day, you could only make curry rice」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Jeez! We agreed not to bring that up」

name: Synn
message: 「S-sorry... no, even I couldn't get good this fast」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Because you're the one who taught me how fun cooking can be, President」

name: Synn
message: 「Not at all! That's not true!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「No, you definitely taught me, President」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That cooking for someone else is such a wonderful thing...」

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Though, truth be told, it was my first time making it alone, so I was a tiny bit worried」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Even so, it turned out delicious. And I'm glad you seemed to enjoy it too, President ♪」
What is this? This warm, burning sensation in my chest.
Having Lolotte by my side, watching her beam with a full smile, my heart won't stop pounding in a way totally different from my usual nervousness.
I want to put these feelings into words so badly I can't stand it.

name: Synn
message: 「L-Lolotte... I, I-I-I-I...!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You want seconds on rice, right ♪ I'll go get it~」
Ah, aah~~. That's not it~~.

name: Lolotte
message: 「I'm stuffed~~\s07」
My stomach is full, my heart is full... is what I'd like to say, though if anything, my heart is completely full of Lolotte.
Since we finally have the place to ourselves, this is the golden opportunity to tell her how I feel.
And yet...
Lolotte doesn't show a hint of that, happily engrossed in reading a knitting magazine.
Even though I'm the older one, I'm so nervous my heart is pounding... How pathetic.
No, no! As her upperclassman, and more importantly as a man, I have to break through this ambiguous situation.

name: Synn
message: 「H-Hey, Lolotte?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I see... So it's ideal as a present~~」
J-Just a little closer--

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte, um...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Oh, President. There's something I don't quite understand.」
Lolotte leans right in close to me.
I catch a gentle, pleasant scent of a girl.

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's this part right here...」

name: Synn
message: 「O-Oh, finishing off the seam?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes. This is the only part I just can't figure out from the diagram.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「So, with that said... here!」
Lolotte holds out the yarn and knitting needles that were lying around.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Please teach me hands-on♪」

name: Synn
message: 「H-Hands-on?」
Saying that, she turns her back to me and drops right into my arms.
Her silky long hair tickles my nose.
I'm by no means on the tall side myself, yet Lolotte, who's even smaller than me, is sitting right in front of me.
Despite having such a cute, petite body, she has an incredible presence to me.

name: Synn
message: 「You take this part like this...」
I take Lolotte's hands and start knitting.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Your hands are so big, President.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ahaha... You think so?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「About two of my fists could fit inside them.」

name: Synn
message: 「I wish my height would grow just as big, though.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I like you just the way you are, President...\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte...?」
Even though Lolotte had been acting so nonchalant just a moment ago, the instant she came inside with me, her cheeks flushed red and she shrank back.

name: Lolotte
message: 「When you hold my hand like this, President, why is it... my body goes all mushy~」

name: Synn
message: 「Not pounding...?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's different from the exciting, thrilling pounding I usually feel when I'm exploring with you, President.」
She looks down bashfully, fidgeting with her fingers.

name: Lolotte
message: 「I really do get embarrassed... Why is that? Even though I'm just staying by your side like this...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「When I'm with you, President, my chest tightens up and feels all bittersweet.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「My body... my heart is acting strange...! That's why I tried to act like I always do in front of you, President, and yet...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I couldn't do it after all... Even so, I still want to stay close to you like this, President. Isn't that strange?」

name: Synn
message: 「N-No, it's not! That's not strange at all...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Then what is this? It's not even written in the guidebook... Please tell me, President...」
Lolotte pleads with a clingy, endearing expression.
She's probably doing it completely unconsciously.
For Lolotte, being an angel, the word 'love' isn't even in her heart's dictionary.
My throat gave a loud gulp.
Right now, surely I can tell her the words that will bring not just our bodies, but our hearts much closer together.

name: Synn
message: 「L-Lolotte...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「...President?」
Lolotte raised her face to check on how I was doing

name: Synn
message: 「Ngho!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「P-P-President!?」
Her adorable head bumped right into my nose with a clunk.
Getting nudged at the exact moment my excitement was about to reach its peak--

name: Lolotte
message: 「W-Waaah! A nosebleed~~! This is terrible~~!」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I'm fine, really! Don't panic so much.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I'm sorry... for making this happen...」

name: Synn
message: 「Don't worry about it, really! Look, we've got the seam all taken care of now... so why don't we play a game or something together!」
I missed another good opportunity...

name: Synn
message: 「Sorry to keep you waiting~~. Here's my way of paying you back for lunch~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yay♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Though it's curry and rice again.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That is more than welcome, you know~\s07」
Ever since then, the two of us have been spending our days off like this, keeping that same "comrade" vibe we've had since we first met.
Taking it easy like this, keeping the same relaxed energy we always share in the Student Council, isn't bad at all.
It really isn't bad.
Still, I want to make things even better.
In order to make these everyday moments I spend with Lolotte even more fulfilling.
I want to build a relationship that goes one step beyond being friends or comrades.
I want to get closer to Lolotte.
Yet, even if I tell her how I feel, would things really turn out for the better?
I have my doubts.
Part of me wonders if leaving our relationship just the way it is might be better.
And yet--

name: Lolotte
message: 「Thank you for the meal~」

name: Synn
message: 「Glad you liked it.」
Lolotte stands up energetically to carry the dishes over to the sink.
However, she stops in front of the door and stands frozen for a while.

name: Synn
message: 「W-What's wrong, Lolotte?」
She has a look as if something is weighing heavily on her mind. Then, looking down, she seems to be holding something back.
Before long, though, she shakes her head and turns a smile toward me.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mr. President. Would you like to go for a little walk?」
Once we stepped outside, the two of us walked along in silence.
Even Lolotte, who is usually brimming with curiosity, seemed lost in thought today.

name: Lolotte
message: 「To tell you the truth, this strange feeling I get didn't just start today.」

name: Synn
message: 「Since before...?」

name: Synn
message: 「Do you know when it happens, or anything like that?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「W-Well, that is...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「There are way too many times for me to tell, you know~~」
I feel the exact same way.
Through all the fun days I've spent with Lolotte, we've laughed, been exasperated, gotten angry, and felt sad.
We've shared all those emotions and lived through them together.
As fellow members of the Student Council, and as Crusaders. A relationship born from such a trivial start.
Yet the days I spent with Lolotte always shone brilliantly.

name: Lolotte
message: 「It used to happen suddenly like a fit from time to time. So I couldn't tell which thing was the cause... 」

name: Lolotte
message: 「But ever since yesterday... my heart hasn't stopped pounding」

name: Synn
message: 「Yesterday...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Even though I kept thinking I wanted to help Azel-san, the moment she said those things--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「My mind went completely blank. I lost all idea of how I should act around her from now on...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It wasn't just yesterday, either. It was the same with the boxed lunch. To tell the truth, I was terribly sad... yet I couldn't just leave her alone...」

name: Synn
message: 「You're really kind, Lolotte」

name: Lolotte
message: 「No, I'm not! In truth, I'm just acting recklessly. That's why, whenever something unexpected happens, I become completely helpless」

name: Lolotte
message: 「And every single time, you were the one who saved me, President」

name: Synn
message: 「I did...?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yesterday, I realized it with absolute clarity. The reason I can spend every day so happily like this is because you've always been by my side, President...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Whether I'm asleep or awake, your face just keeps floating fuzzily into my mind, President」

name: Lolotte
message: 「This feeling... it's different from gratitude... I want to convey it properly... and yet...」

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte. In that case, I... might feel the exact same way」

name: Synn
message: 「I want to be together with you too, Lolotte」

name: Synn
message: 「I love you, Lolotte」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, I'm sure of it. If I'm going to put this feeling into words, I think that's the best way to say it」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Love...」

name: Synn
message: 「I like you as a girl, Lolotte.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「As a girl...」

name: Synn
message: 「I want you by my side, and I want to be by yours. Forever, if I can.」
Even while getting pulled around by her, I had so much fun. Those irreplaceable days I spent with Lolotte.
Those sparkling days I never could have discovered on my own.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Love... President loves me... And I...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Love you...!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I love... I love you! I love you! I really do!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I love you so much!!」
As soon as she cried out energetically, Lolotte's face lit up brightly.
Unlike her usual smile full of curiosity, it was an expression of pure joy at having conveyed her feelings.

name: Lolotte
message: 「I love you! I love you! Yay! I said it♪ I love you, I love you, I love you!」

name: Synn
message: 「L-Lolotte... Y-You don't have to say it that much... It's embarrassing\s03」

name: Lolotte
message: 「No, I'll say it as many times as I want!」

name: Synn
message: 「It feels like I've turned into a hamburger steak or curry rice.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Wha--!! That's not it at all!」
That's right. There was nothing to be afraid of.
I love Lolotte just the way she is, and Lolotte loves me just the way I am.
Sharing our feelings and connecting with each other doesn't change anything.
Because the two of us can stay together forever.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Consulting with you really was the right choice, President♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Asking the person themselves isn't something people normally do, you know?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ehehe\s07 That just goes to show how dependable you are, President♪」

name: Synn
message: 「B-But does this mean Lolotte and I... are lovers now?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Lo... vers」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ooh!! So this is what they call 'lovers' in all the rumors. If I remember right, there was a section on this in the guidebook.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, hold on... You probably shouldn't trust that thing too--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hmm, hmm... Ooh!?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I hear that lovers... kiss.」

name: Synn
message: 「Pfft!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Kissing is... if I remember correctly, pressing your lips together... smooch~~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「H-Huh?! Lovers smooch each other!!」

name: Synn
message: 「N-No! It's not something you have to rush into like that...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「B-But... you do it, right?」
If she asks me with upturned eyes like that... it's gonna make me want to kiss her.

name: Synn
message: 「W-Well, yeah... eventually.」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I-It's okay. It doesn't have to be today; we can do it anytime we want\s01」

name: Lolotte
message: 「No!! Let's kiss after all!」

name: Synn
message: 「Wha-- You don't... have to force yourself, you know?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I'm not forcing myself at all. It's just...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Whatever would become of me on the day I kiss the person I love so dearly...」
N-No good... It just looks like Lolotte is begging for it.

name: Synn
message: 「A-All right... Then, I'm going to... kiss you.」
We face each other awkwardly.
So she won't notice how I'm trembling from nerves, I wrap my arm firmly around Lolotte's waist.
And the very instant I try to pull her toward me--

name: Lolotte
message: 「...Mmph.」
Lolotte rises onto her tiptoes, reaching up to press her lips to mine.
Drawn into the lips offered to me, Lolotte and I--

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mmph... chu...」
Share a lovers' kiss.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mmm... mfuu...」
We stay pressed together like that for a while, our trembling shoulders and arms not moving a muscle.
The feel of her soft lips, and a sweet-and-sour taste...
From where our lips meet, Lolotte's feelings come pouring in, filling my heart.
Filling me with Lolotte.
It was the moment we crossed the line from friends and became lovers.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Nn... chupu... nmu, puha--!」
I felt a literal pang of regret as our lips unintentionally parted.
If only I could stay connected with Lolotte like this forever.

name: Lolotte
message: 「We kissed, didn't we...\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yeah...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Just as I thought... I'm surprised...」

name: Synn
message: 「Eh, w-was something wrong?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「No, it's not that... um... my head feels all fuzzy...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It felt so good, like I might just lose myself like this~~」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I see」
I felt the exact same way, yet I wanted to keep surrendering myself to that pleasant sensation forever.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ehehe. With this, I've joined the ranks of adults~♪」

name: Synn
message: 「You're exaggerating, it was just a kiss」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It seems neither Senpai, nor the Vice President, nor the Treasurer has ever had a lover's kiss, you know」

name: Synn
message: 「Wh-wh-what, how do you know something like that!?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「What are you saying? I am a proper girl, after all. Talking about things like that is completely natural」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You shouldn't get flustered over something on that level either, President」

name: Lolotte
message: 「However, it can't be helped. They say in this world that girls are more mature than boys, after all. Ahem!」
Ugh... even though Lolotte is the younger one...

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's why I took the plunge and acted all grown-up♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Th-then... wanna try acting even more grown-up?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Eh」
Missing Lolotte's lips, I kissed her again.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hapu... nmu, nn... nnnuh...」
Merely pressing our lips together wasn't enough to be called grown-up.
Mustering my courage, in order to protect my dignity as the older one, into that small mouth--

name: Lolotte
message: 「Nn... nchu, chuu... fumuhn...?」
She seemed to notice that unfamiliar sensation.
Parting her lips, I slipped into Lolotte's mouth.
Lolotte's eyes went wide, looking almost flustered.
However, that shock was only fleeting. Her eyes grew moist with ecstasy, and her eyelids slowly drooped.
I slowly closed my eyes as well, focusing all my senses on the tip of my tongue.
Inside Lolotte's warm, wet mouth, I lightly tapped against her squirming tongue.
Noticing this, Lolotte gave a tiny shiver, as if answering my movements.
With the plump, springy feel of our tongues, we stimulated one another.
Even more than the light kiss from earlier, I was overcome by a sensation as though my entire body were melting away.

name: Synn
message: 「...H-How is it?」
Still in a trance, Lolotte smiled bashfully and adorably.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Oh my...?」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa, looks like it really is time」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It is getting quite late, after all」

name: Synn
message: 「It's a little sad, though it's not like this is goodbye forever」

name: Lolotte
message: 「--Hello, Sebastian? Yes, I'm at Tsukinoo Park with the President. Let's see, we were just kissing」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, Lolotte!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Oh, what's the harm? I simply couldn't keep something so wonderful a secret」
Good grief, no matter how much time passes, I'm always completely at Lolotte's mercy.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ufufu, I must inform Amyrina today as well!」
At this rate, everyone will probably know by tomorrow.
Though it's true there's no reason to hide it.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Surely not, Mr. President, but you aren't embarrassed about everyone finding out, are you?」

name: Synn
message: 「N-No way...」
Gah! Don't get embarrassed, don't get embarrassed!

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, screw it, whatever happens, happens!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's the spirit~♪」
That day was the happiest day of their lives for the two of them.
